findings.issue: Internal campaign workspace was publicly reachable through GitHub Pages.
findings.evidence: Representative markdown, JSON, privacy-review, and source-image URLs returned HTTP 200.
findings.recommendation: Exclude content-deployment from Pages and keep the exclusion validator-enforced.

findings.issue: No public privacy notice accompanies Formspree lead collection and Google Analytics.
findings.evidence: The form collects name, phone, optional email, and job details; no privacy-policy route exists.
findings.recommendation: Publish an owner-approved truthful privacy notice and add a concise form disclosure.

findings.issue: Shared navigation and estimate links used the duplicate /index.html homepage URL.
findings.evidence: Every generated page linked /index.html fragments while /index.html returned 200 and canonicalized to /.
findings.recommendation: Use root fragments and reject /index.html internal links in validation.

findings.issue: Primary conversion actions are not measured as analytics events.
findings.evidence: GA pageview code is present; no SMS, telephone, form-success, service, or project events are emitted.
findings.recommendation: Define a small approved GA event taxonomy and instrument primary conversions.

findings.issue: Property-cost, estate-cost, timeline, and rental guides share substantial vocabulary.
findings.evidence: Semantic similarity is high, but headings and primary decisions remain distinct.
findings.recommendation: Monitor Search Console query/page pairing before consolidation or further variants.

findings.issue: Pineville shares substantial structure with Alexandria and could become a doorway template if scaled.
findings.evidence: Current page remains unique enough, but location-page similarity is the strongest page-type overlap.
findings.recommendation: Do not add more city pages without unique local usefulness and verified project evidence.

findings.issue: Only one project case study supports the entire service and location architecture.
findings.evidence: The single Alexandria project is strong but is the only project route.
findings.recommendation: Add privacy-approved real projects before expanding generic content or locations.

findings.issue: The build source is monolithic and retains dormant legacy homepage/project blocks.
findings.evidence: The file is approximately 198 KB and combines services, areas, articles, feed, and legacy/current content ownership.
findings.recommendation: Modularize only with exact-output and validator parity tests.

findings.issue: The default hero-truck PNG is approximately 2.68 MB and generic for several page types.
findings.evidence: It is used in default Open Graph/Twitter metadata; normal page rendering uses smaller assets.
findings.recommendation: Use smaller social-compatible and page-relevant authentic images.

findings.issue: FAQ summary controls are about 25.6 CSS pixels high.
findings.evidence: They exceed the 24px WCAG 2.2 minimum but are below the site's preferred 44px comfort target.
findings.recommendation: Increase the summary hit area during a future component pass.

findings.evidence: Business attribution appears in schema but not as a visible byline/profile path.
findings.recommendation: Add accurate organization or named-author attribution only after approval.

findings.issue: Architecture documentation omitted five articles and described removed homepage/review behavior.
findings.evidence: Documented routes and integrations did not match the generated site or script.
findings.recommendation: Update the repository documentation to current architecture.

findings.issue: No orphan, broken internal link, bad canonical, sitemap mismatch, invalid schema, or mobile overflow was found.
findings.evidence: All 24 routes returned 200; route graph depth is 0-2; validator and 72 browser checks passed.
findings.recommendation: Preserve current architecture and regression guards.
